load_evaluate_toxicity_module: load the huggingface evaluate toxicity module for text toxicity analysis
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for interactive toxicity evaluation using the loaded module
evaluate_toxicity_predictions: evaluate toxicity predictions on text samples using the loaded toxicity module
compute_toxicity_scores: compute toxicity scores for input text using the huggingface evaluate toxicity metric
run_toxicity_gradio_demo: run the gradio demo interface for the huggingface evaluate toxicity measurement
